strings.name: Pavel Durov
strings.country: Russian-born; citizen of France, the UAE and Saint Kitts and Nevis
strings.summary: Durov founded VKontakte before developing Telegram with his brother Nikolai, attracting global users through cross-device communication and platform independence. His career also encompasses moderation disputes, securities regulation and French and Russian investigations; he denies the alleged wrongdoing.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He founded VKontakte and co-founded Telegram, influencing instant messaging, platform governance and debates about online privacy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Leningrad, Soviet Union, now Saint Petersburg, Russia.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Graduated from Saint Petersburg State University in 2006, studying English philology and translation.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building a global communications platform
strings.highlights.h1.text: Pavel provided Telegram’s financing, direction and management; Nikolai developed MTProto. Ordinary cloud chats and end-to-end encrypted Secret Chats use different models.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Privacy advocacy and governance duties
strings.highlights.h2.text: Known for privacy and platform independence, he also faces allegations over illegal content and law-enforcement cooperation; these disputes are a material part of his career.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Facing new Russian charges
strings.timeline.t1.text: Russia’s FSB announced charges of facilitating terrorism and sought to place him on a wanted list. He and Telegram rejected the accusations; charges are not a conviction.
strings.timeline.t2.title: French travel restrictions lifted
strings.timeline.t2.text: French authorities removed his travel ban and reporting requirements, while the formal investigation concerning illegal Telegram content continued.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Detention and investigation in France
strings.timeline.t3.text: He was arrested at an airport near Paris, then released under judicial supervision; the inquiry concerned criminal content and cooperation with law enforcement.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Introducing Telegram Premium
strings.timeline.t4.text: The platform added subscriptions for advanced features, extending revenue sources alongside earlier public-channel advertising.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Settling the SEC Gram case
strings.timeline.t5.text: Telegram companies agreed to return over $1.2 billion to investors and pay an $18.5 million civil penalty, without admitting or denying the SEC allegations.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Telegram blocked in Russia
strings.timeline.t6.text: A Moscow court ordered blocking after the platform refused to hand over decryption keys; restrictions were lifted in 2020.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Leaving VKontakte
strings.timeline.t7.text: After selling his remaining stake and ending his chief executive role, he left Russia and focused on Telegram.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Telegram launches
strings.timeline.t8.text: Telegram, developed with Nikolai, launched its iOS app as a communications product separate from VKontakte.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Graduating and founding VKontakte
strings.timeline.t9.text: After university studies in language and translation, he launched VKontakte and entered large-scale internet platform management.
